english.title: Person under 15 years of age possess assembled shotgun
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a person under the age of 15, had with you an assembled shotgun, namely **(..SPECIFY SHOTGUN..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 22(3) of and Schedule 6 to the Firearms Act 1968.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
person under 15
had with him
assembled shotgun

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) See the exceptions referred to in section 22(3), i.e. whilst under the supervision of a person of or over 21, or whilst the shotgun is so covered with a securely fastened gun cover that it cannot be fired.
(ii) Deemed a PNC recordable offence by virtue of the Schedule to the National Police Records (Recordable Offences) Regulations 2000. S.I. 2000/1139 refers.

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level three on the standard scale.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
